{"code": "import pandas as pd

data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate by keeping the row with the highest sample_seq for each patient_id
deduplicated_data = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Count unique patients
unique_patients_count = len(deduplicated_data)
print(unique_patients_count)"}
